entries.name: Restel Oy, press release: Taco Bell opens in Seinäjoki, 21 restaurants soon (5 Aug 2026)
entries.claim: Taco Bell in Finland since 2017; with Seinäjoki soon 21 restaurants. Restel runs about 200 restaurants, about 2,200 staff.

entries.name: Nordic Bites Group Oy, press release: buys nine Subway restaurants in Finland (27 Mar 2026)
entries.claim: NBG is Subway master franchisee for Finland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark; exclusive rights over 370+ restaurants; owns and runs 100+ from 1 Apr 2026; bought nine Finnish sites; minority investors Juuri Partners and Arvo.

entries.name: Vero Skatt, Withholding tax at source on dividends, interest and royalties (guidance issued 4 Aug 2022)
entries.claim: Tax at source on royalties to non-residents is 20% to a corporate entity, 30% otherwise; treaty or EU-directive relief needs evidence per payment.

entries.name: Apollo Group OÜ, interim report Q4 and 12 months 2025/2026 (period to 30 Apr 2026)
entries.claim: 3 KFC restaurants opened in Finland in the year, 8 in Finland at 30 Apr 2026, 30 in the Baltics; Finland and Estonia 'challenging'; 7% of 3,705 staff in Finland; EUR 50m bond at 7%.

entries.name: Hesburger (Burger-In Oy), release 7 Oct 2026: Hesburger is more than a restaurant chain
entries.claim: About 6,000 staff in Finland; 2025 taxable sales in Finland about EUR 327m; five Doner HeseKebab & Gyros restaurants in Finland (three Turku, one Vantaa, Salo Kivihovi).

entries.name: MTV Uutiset, 'KFC-ravintolaketju saapuu Suomeen' (10 Mar 2021)
entries.claim: KFC Finland rights went to Apollo Group in 2021. A 2018 plan for up to 50 restaurants stalled because no suitable franchisee was found.

entries.name: Varma, Social security contributions and limits 2026
entries.claim: 2026: TyEL basic 24.85% (employee 7.30%), sickness insurance 1.91%, unemployment 0.31%, accident 0.51% average.

entries.name: Borenius, legal alert: corporate tax cut proposed (8 May 2026)
entries.claim: Draft proposal of 28 Apr 2026 cuts corporate tax from 20% to 18% from tax year 2027; withholding on dividends, interest and royalties to non-residents to 18%; treaty rates still apply where lower.

entries.name: Finnish Government, Lupa- ja valvontaviraston maksut 2026 (11 Dec 2025)
entries.claim: Licensing and Supervisory Agency fees for 2026 confirmed. Alcohol administration fees are not raised, with some exceptions; short pop-up serving licences fall.

entries.name: PAM, Matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluiden työehdot (pay tables from 1 Jun 2026)
entries.claim: Pay group 2 (waiter, cashier, cook in fast-food and cafes), 0-2 years: EUR 1,942 a month, EUR 12.21 an hour from 1 Jun 2026. Evening supplement EUR 1.40, night EUR 2.37 an hour; double on Sundays and holidays.

entries.name: ECB, euro reference rate for pound sterling (rate 13 Nov 2026: 0.83559)
entries.claim: EUR/GBP reference rate 0.83559 on 13 Nov 2026 (0.83415 on 6 Nov).

entries.name: Eurostat, nama_10_pc: GDP per capita, current prices (API pull 16 Nov 2026)
McDonald's Suomi, Taustatiedote 1 Sep 2026
entries.claim: 89 restaurants in 46 cities on 1 Sep 2026; 67 (75%) run by 12 franchisees; Finland sales EUR 341.2m in 2025 (+3%), 331.2m in 2024, 313.5m in 2023, 274.1m in 2022; about 4,300 staff; base pay EUR 11.87 an hour, average EUR 16.16 with supplements (2025).

entries.name: Hesburger, release 10 Sep 2026: solar power at the Kaarina plant
entries.claim: Hesburger states 258 restaurants in Finland (10 Sep 2026).

entries.name: Hesburger, release 22 Sep 2026: Finnish family firm challenges American giants
entries.claim: 179 restaurants in the Baltics (Lithuania 70, Estonia 54, Latvia 55); 240 abroad in total; Hesburger is market leader by restaurant count in Finland and the Baltics.

entries.name: NoHo Partners Oyj, Vuosikertomus 2025 (annual report)
entries.claim: Better Burger Society left the NoHo group from 1 Apr 2025 (BBS sales EUR 94m in 2025, up 17%). NoHo bought 75% of Jungle Juice Bar (40 units in Finland) on 1 Sep 2025 and a majority of Halifax Burgers (11 units, Denmark) on 1 May 2025.

entries.name: KFC Finland, Ravintolat page (store locator and opening-hours table), counted 16 Nov 2026
entries.claim: Hours table lists 9 restaurants: Itis, Sello, Iso Omena, Turku, Seinäjoki, Tripla, Kamppi, Redi, Kolme Seppä. Operator APL Fresh Food Oy (Apollo).

entries.name: Hesburger press release list (STT), including Doner HeseKebab opening 13 May 2026 and FoodStation Tallinn 6 Nov 2026
entries.claim: Hesburger opened its tenth Doner HeseKebab & Gyros restaurant in Turku on 13 May 2026; first FoodStation (kebab, pizza, coffee under one roof) opened in Tallinn on 5 Nov 2026 with EUR 600,000 invested. The 7 Oct release says five in Finland: the two figures conflict and the lower is used.

entries.name: Restel Oy newsroom (STT), release list to 3 Nov 2026
entries.claim: Restel runs Burger King, Taco Bell, Rax Pizzabuffet, Wanha Mestari, Classic Pizza, Makaronitehdas; Huili roadside break-stops opened at about one a week on Neste stations Nov 2025 to Feb 2026; Restel Taukopaikat change negotiations 27 Aug 2026; Burger King Ali-Kerava opened 7 Jan 2026.

entries.name: Hesburger, release 1 Oct 2026: coffee sales and Kivihovi test
entries.claim: Hesburger sold 2,522,118 cups of coffee in Finland from 1 Sep 2025 to 31 Aug 2026; filter coffee dominates; espresso drinks being tested at Salo Kivihovi.

entries.name: Hesburger, release 6 Nov 2026: first FoodStation opens in Tallinn
entries.claim: FoodStation joins Doner HeseKebab & Gyros (five in Finland), Ahju Pizzeria (known in Finland as UUNI) and HeseCafe under one roof at a Neste station; EUR 600,000 investment; Estonia has 54 Hesburgers.

entries.name: Kotipizza Group Oy newsroom (STT), release list to 3 Nov 2026
entries.claim: Kotipizza states 'over 300' restaurants, all franchised; accessibility data published for 'over 300' on 29 Sep 2026; parent The European Pizza Company, part of Orkla; 'over 90' fuel stations.

entries.name: Kotipizza Group, release 18 Mar 2026: sells Social Burgerjoint
entries.claim: Kotipizza Group sold the Social Burgerjoint concept (Helsinki Redi and Citycenter, Tampere) to Artisan Fast Food Oy, whose owner has been a franchisee since 2020.

entries.name: Kotipizza Group, release 24 Mar 2026: more than ten new Kotipizza sites at Neste/Huili stations
entries.claim: Kotipizza is present at over 90 fuel stations; more than ten new restaurants planned beside Huili rest stops from March 2026.

entries.name: MTV Uutiset, kebab boom in Finland (6 Oct 2023)
entries.claim: Premium kebab wave: S-Group launched Babista (first in Mikkeli, plan up to 20), DIF Doner, Hesburger's HeseKebab as a separate concept.

entries.name: Statistics Finland, Services turnover index June 2026 (31 Jul 2026)
entries.claim: Accommodation and food service turnover +2.4%, volume +1.1% in June 2026 against June 2025 (working-day adjusted).

entries.name: Finavia, Fazer Cafe to open at Helsinki Airport (9 Oct 2025)
entries.claim: Fazer Cafe opens at Helsinki Airport in early 2026, operated by SSP Finland as partner: a licensed-operator route for a bakery-cafe brand.

entries.name: PRH, Fees for trademark applications and registrations from 1 Jan 2026
entries.claim: National trademark: EUR 250 online (one class), EUR 100 per extra class; renewal EUR 250; fees updated 20 May 2026.

entries.name: Ruokavirasto, Setting up a cafe or a restaurant
entries.claim: Food premises registration announcement due no later than 4 weeks before opening, via Ilppa; hygiene passports and an own-check plan required; registration and control are chargeable.

entries.name: Finnish Franchising Association, Franchising legislation (Properta, Feb 2024)
entries.claim: No franchise-specific law and no disclosure statute; general contract, competition and unfair-practice law apply; EU vertical block exemption 2022/720 applies; Competition Act bans minimum resale prices; arbitration clauses accepted (KKO:1996:27).

entries.name: Suomen Franchising-Yhdistys, Franchisingyrittajyys (Franchising Barometri 2025)
entries.claim: About 250-300 franchise chains in Finland, 31% in restaurants, cafes and fast food; 80% domestic; about 5,000 franchisees, 7,000 outlets, over EUR 7bn turnover (Barometri 2025).

entries.name: Vero, Rates of VAT (updated 1 Jan 2026)
entries.claim: Reduced VAT rate 13.5% from 1 Jan 2026 (14% before) on restaurant and meal services; general rate 25.5%; the reduced rate does not cover alcohol.

entries.name: Taloustaito, 'Yrittajaksi ison ketjun taustatuella' (24 Jul 2026)
entries.claim: Typical Finnish franchise fees: joining fee a few thousand euro, service fee 5-10% of turnover, marketing fee 1-5%; about 6,000 franchise firms employ about 100,000 (association estimate).

entries.name: BURGER KING Suomi newsroom (STT), release list to 19 May 2026
entries.claim: Kokkola (Aug 2023) was the chain's 64th Finnish restaurant; five more planned by end 2025 (11 Nov 2025); Ali-Kerava 7 Jan 2026, Ala-Tikkurila with Taco Bell 5 Mar 2026, Jyvaskyla Seppala autumn 2026. Burger King Finland run by Restel.

entries.name: Jungle Juice Bar, About us (company site)
entries.claim: Finland's first juice and smoothie bar (2011); company states 'over 50 bars now operating' (brand claim, not a count).

entries.name: MTV Uutiset / STT, NoHo Partners buys Jungle Juice Bar majority (2 Sep 2025)
entries.claim: NoHo bought 75% of Jungle Juice Bar, a chain of 41 bars in Finland; founders stay as minority owners; competition authority cleared the deal.

entries.name: Wolt Helsinki, Qitea brand page (listing check 16 Nov 2026)
entries.claim: Qitea bubble tea: two listed delivery venues (Kaivokatu, Tripla) shown on the Helsinki brand page; Wolt lists more areas; independent chain of a few shops.

entries.name: Wolt Helsinki, Better Kebab brand page (listing check 16 Nov 2026)
entries.claim: Better Kebab lists five Helsinki outlets on Wolt: Kaartinkaupunki, Kamppi, Kluuvi, Toolo, Ullanlinna.

entries.name: Kaleva, 'Babista Oulu suljettiin' (25 Feb 2025)
entries.claim: S-Group's kebab concept Babista closed its Oulu restaurant (Valkea) on 25 Feb 2025 because it did not do well enough: a kebab-chain exit signal.

entries.name: Statistics Finland, preliminary population statistics September 2026 (22 Oct 2026)
entries.claim: Population 5,662,086 at end of September 2026; +9,205 in Jan-Sep, all from migration (births 36,323, deaths 43,990).

entries.name: SOK (S-Group), release 16 Jun 2026: Hesburger franchise renewed for 10 years
entries.claim: S-Group operates 106 Hesburger restaurants (mostly Prisma and ABC stations) under franchise since 1999; 10-year renewal signed; aim to grow the network.

entries.name: Subway newsroom, master franchise agreement with Nordic Bites Group (20 May 2025)
entries.claim: NBG gets exclusive rights over nearly 400 Subway restaurants in the Nordics; plans 250+ new by 2032 (to 600+); NBG subsidiaries own and run over 80 in Finland and Sweden; Juuri Partners minority since 2023.

entries.name: Eurostat news (via NSI Bulgaria copy), price levels 2024: restaurants and hotels
entries.claim: Restaurants and hotels price level 2024 (EU=100): Denmark 148, Ireland 129, Finland 127. Source dataset prc_ppp_ind.

entries.name: Friends & Brgrs, release 28 Oct 2026: Lahti Laune opens, 39th restaurant
entries.claim: Domestic burger chain states 39 restaurants (about 800 staff), four with drive-through; next sites Lohja Dec 2026 and Hameenlinna early 2027; target five new in 2027.

entries.name: Friends & Brgrs, release 11 Jun 2026: 35 own bakeries
entries.claim: 35 restaurants on 11 Jun 2026, each baking its own buns. With 39 on 28 Oct 2026 the chain added four in under five months.

entries.name: Asiakastieto, Friends & Brgrs Ab Oy company page (read 16 Nov 2026)
entries.claim: 2025 turnover EUR 37.3m (+17.1%), operating profit EUR 3.8m (9.9%), 728 staff.

entries.name: Statistics Finland, Palkkarakenne 2024 (release 8 Jun 2026)
entries.claim: Median total monthly earnings of full-time employees EUR 3,615 in 2024; lowest in accommodation and food service at EUR 2,720 (lowest tenth up to EUR 2,107).

entries.name: Finavia, Fazer Cafe opened at Helsinki Airport (27 Feb 2026)
entries.claim: First Fazer Cafe in an airport opened 27 Feb 2026, run by SSP Finland, pastries baked at Fazer's Sornainen bakery.

entries.name: Asiakastieto, Fazer Ravintolat Oy financials (read 16 Nov 2026)
entries.claim: Fazer Cafe operator turnover EUR 25.3m (2021), 34.6m, 38.7m, 41.1m, 44.7m (2025); operating loss EUR 0.3m in 2025 (3.2m in 2021); staff 253 to 363.

entries.name: Asiakastieto, Espresso House Finland Oy (read 16 Nov 2026)
entries.claim: 2025 turnover EUR 50.3m (+0.7%), operating profit EUR 503,000 (1.0%), 411 staff. No cafe count published; flat sales.

entries.name: McDonald's Suomi, release 26 Mar 2026: market leader sixth year
entries.claim: 90 restaurants, 69 (about 77%) run by 12 local franchisees; 10 opened in 2025; sales EUR 341.2m (+3%); average restaurant about EUR 4m a year, about 60 staff.

entries.name: Etela-Pohjanmaan Osuuskauppa (Eepee), half-year release 2026
entries.claim: Restaurant revenue fell 5.6% in Jan-Jun 2026 on the year, partly from closing the Babista restaurant; Kivisto to get Rosso Pizza and Hesburger late 2026.

entries.name: Food Chain magazine, issue 207 (Aug 2025), Kotipizza Group
entries.claim: Kotipizza Group described as running over 300 locations in Finland (trade press, a claim not a count).

entries.name: Verkkouutiset, Talsa list of Finland's largest restaurant chains
entries.claim: Kotipizza, Hesburger and Subway are the only restaurant chains with over 100 sites in Finland (date not shown on the page; used as context only).

entries.name: Taco Bell Finland, Ravintolat page (opened in owner's browser 16 Nov 2026)
entries.claim: Locator list does not load without script: no count taken from it. Page says Taco Bell has traded in Finland since 2017. The count of 21 comes from the Restel release of 5 Aug 2026.

entries.name: Focus Taiwan, Taiwanese boba in Finland (28 Jan 2026)
entries.claim: A Taiwanese-Swiss founder is rebuilding Taiwanese boba in Finland after an earlier venture closed in 2015; bubble tea here is a small independent scene, not a chain market (single source, Thin).

entries.name: Minilex, Osakeyhtion perustaminen PRH:ssa (law-advice summary; fee date not confirmed)
entries.claim: A private limited company (Oy) needs no minimum share capital; founding notice fee about EUR 240 online (EUR 380 on paper); notice due within three months of signing. Secondary source: check against PRH before use.

entries.name: PRH, Kaupparekisteriin tehtävien perustamisilmoitusten hinnat (Oy notice EUR 400; guided package EUR 300), updated 1 Jan 2026
entries.claim: Trade Register processing fee for a private limited company founding notice is EUR 400, or EUR 300 for the guided package in YTJ, VAT 0%.

entries.name: PRH, Osakeyhtiön ohjattu perustamispaketti YTJ-palvelussa, updated 13 Aug 2026
entries.claim: Guided package costs EUR 300 and needs share capital of EUR 0 and a Finnish personal ID for every person involved.
